$comment: RFC 0262 §A — the telemetry family's facets. `otlp` is required: present means the host exports OTLP traces per spec/v2/core/telemetry.md. `genAiSemconv` is optional: present means model-call spans carry that version's gen_ai.* attributes (§C).

protocols.description: RFC 0262 §A, §B.1 — the OTLP transports the host can export traces over, to the endpoint the operator configures with the standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* settings.

otlp.description: RFC 0262 §B — advertising telemetry binds the export rules in spec/v2/core/telemetry.md: an openwop.run span per run, an openwop.node.<typeId> span per node execution, an inbound traceparent continued, and no credential material or resolved secret in any exported span.

genAiSemconv.description: RFC 0262 §C — the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-conventions version the host maps model calls to. With it, each model-call span MUST carry the gen_ai.* attributes that version defines for a chat call: operation name, provider, request model, and input and output token usage. Absent means no GenAI mapping claim.
